newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: FOUR NEW COMPANIES LISTED ON BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: FOUR NEW COMPANIES LISTED ON BOURSE.

text.p: The stock exchange said on Monday that its board decided to list five new share issues of four companies on the list of the Vilnius bourse.
The bourse said in a statement that its board board allowed block trading and central market transactions in the ordinary shares of the following companies from June 16:

- Merkurijus department store - 670,000 shares, one share face value of one litas, total nominal value of the issue 670,000 litas and 1,248,871 shares, one share face value of one litas, total nominal value of the issue 1,248,871 litas.
The bourse said that the financial situation of the company should be taken into account since it reported losses for the first quarter of the year.
- Klaipedos Maistas - 1,095,048 shares, one share face value of five litas, total nominal value of the issue 5,475,240 litas.
- Markuchiai - 458,414 sahres, one share face value seven litas, total nominal value of the issue 3,208,898 litas.
- Ranga - 39,970 shares, one share face value of nine litas, total nominal value of the issue 359,730 litas.
